title: Curriculum-Guided Acquisition of Hierarchical Task Knowledge from LLM-Generated Experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.34677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical task knowledge enables efficient problem solving by allowing previously acquired skills to be reused across tasks and problem instances. In this paper, we investigate curriculum-guided acquisition of hierarchical task knowledge in an HTN learning framework. We compare three approaches: online learning during problem solving, human-designed curricula, and an automated curriculum generation procedure that derives learning experiences from verified LLM-generated solution traces. The proposed procedure solves small training problems with an LLM, extracts task accomplishment information, and transforms it into ordered sequences of state-task learning problems for HTN method acquisition. translated_title: 基于课程引导从大语言模型生成经验中获取分层任务知识
translated_abstract: 分层任务知识通过使先前习得的技能能够跨任务和问题实例进行复用，从而实现高效的问题求解。本文在HTN（分层任务网络）学习框架中研究了课程引导的分层任务知识获取方法。我们比较了三种方法：问题求解过程中的在线学习、人工设计的课程，以及一种自动课程生成方法，该方法从经过验证的大语言模型生成的解题轨迹中获取学习经验。所提出的方法利用大语言模型求解小型训练问题，提取任务完成信息，并将其转换为用于HTN方法获取的有序状态-任务学习问题序列。我们在多个规划领域对三种方法进行了评估。结果表明，自动生成的课程能够获得接近专家设计课程的大部分收益，同时显著降低了在线分层学习的token成本。
tldr: 本文提出一种自动课程生成方法，通过验证大语言模型生成的小型问题求解轨迹来构建有序的学习序列，从而在HTN框架中自动获取分层任务知识，其效果接近专家设计的课程，且大幅降低了在线学习的成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated curriculum generation method that builds ordered learning sequences from verified LLM-generated solution traces of small problems, enabling automatic acquisition of hierarchical task knowledge in the HTN framework, achieving performance close to expert-designed curricula while substantially reducing online learning token costs.
